name: Pressure transducers
function: Electronic pressure sensors on the header and on each branch that report treating pressure to the data van and confirm that a closed branch is isolated.

tabs.overview: Transducers are mounted on a needle-valved port so they can be isolated and changed; readings are compared with the treating pressure at the pumps to check for line friction and leaks.
tabs.engineering: Rated to the line pressure; calibration checked before the job.
tabs.safety: A transducer port is a small-bore high-pressure connection; it is bled before the sensor is changed.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
